scope: Actual x86_64 Cocoa execution in locally modified installed Darling, with only errno/futex/libsimple replaced by Rust. Not a clean pinned full runtime or arbitrary third-party app compatibility.

apps.TextEditor: Unchanged Cocotron sample sources and nibs; real XTest mouse click and keyboard text, manually verified rendered content in both screenshots. Saving/printing not verified.
apps.Calculator: Purpose-built Cocoa fixture; mapped window and AppKit button actions assert42 and visiblewindow, exit0 in both variants.

manual_visual_qa: Parent inspected original and Rust TextEditor screenshots; exact rust gui edit verified is rendered. Prior run independently inspected by a second agent. Calculator screenshot shows real controls before timed selftest; log proves result42.
fixed_verification_bugs: Inherited stdout/stderr PIPE descriptors held by daemon hung capture after launcher exit; bounded file capture fixes it.
Timed-out launcher or stale child-exit file could create misleading result; explicit status/timeout checks and freshcaptures now reject these.
Missing private/tmp writablefixture and /home caused shared false file-test failures; prepare them before boot.
Shutdown could signal setuid-root launcher too soon and raise EPERM, losing reports; wait for namespace shutdown, bounded reap, record denied signals and fail on unreaped cleanup.
Mesa native shadercache tried guest HOME /Users on host; GUI harness supplies its owned native cache directory.
runtime_audit: No confirmed implementation defect reproduced in Rust atomics/futex/errno/cerror source audit. Real SIGUSR1/EINTR retry passes pinnedC/nativeRust/DarlingRust-chain differentials. No assertion of absence of all bugs.
remaining_limits: Clean pinned complete runtime, i386 Rust backend and cancellation semantics remain unverified.
Legacy lockset_create returns KERN_FAILURE unconditionally; migrated Rust locks are not reached.
Legacy proc_info call1 returns ENOTSUP; no replacement implemented in this work.
General GUI or commercial app compatibility is not established. Existing Riot/League prefix and installed files preserved.
